name: com.rlmg.toolscore
description: A set of Monobehaviours and static Utility classes for Rollmuggers to use for essential app management Unity.

samples.description: Shared assets necessary for most examples.
Demonstrates use of the AttractVideoPlayer prefab, which manages the playback, visibility, and raycast blocking of a video on a RawImage, dismissable with any user input.
Demonstrates the use of RLMGConfigLoader to configure all the other components in RLMG Core at runtime, including the logger, attract video player, and app manager.
